propositions: Current clarity-score computation rewards volume and legacy shape rather than author-guide leaf/container contracts, allowing padded plans to pass without grounded Scope or Approach.
Clarity scoring logic is duplicated across gates.py and det_floor.py, creating maintenance risk and drift potential.

Documented plan-writing guidance and deterministic clarity checks are misaligned; semantic judgments (persona quality, alternative rationale) are conflated with mechanically testable structural requirements.
Author guide prescribes Success Criteria for containers but active tickets (1386, child 44c7) have collapsed it into Acceptance Criteria, creating false guidance.

Seven deterministic additions (required-section shape by altitude, per-AC verification coverage, placeholder detection, grounded edit-set with file_impact, AC text hygiene, Testing shape markers) are mechanically testable without code change but require unified scoring logic to replace raw length and point accumulation.
